title: Inpatient claim filing deadline
text: Submit inpatient claims within 45 calendar days of discharge. Refer unclear claims to a human reviewer.

title: Inpatient claim filing deadline
text: Submit inpatient claims within 30 calendar days of discharge, with the itemized bill and discharge summary. Human reviewer decides claims.

title: Dependent enrollment required documents
text: Dependent enrollment requires proof of relationship and employee enrollment identifier. Specialist verifies coverage.

title: Endorsement effective date backdating
text: Do not backdate endorsement effective dates without compliance review and insurer confirmation.

title: Employer premium invoice due
text: Employer premium invoices are due 10 calendar days after the invoice issue date. Billing specialist reviews disputes.

title: Inpatient claim filing deadline
text: Other insurer requires inpatient claims within 20 calendar days. Human claims review is required.
